channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: Malaysia Open: PV Sindhu, Satwik-Chirag advance to second round; Treesa-Gayatri exit
item.description: Sindhu defeated lower-ranked Sung Shuo-yun of Chinese Taipei in straight games to begin her year on a good note.

item.title: Middle-distance star and Olympian Jinson Johnson announces retirement
item.description: The national record holder became the first Indian in 56 years to win a 1500m Asian Games gold medal in 2018.

item.title: India Open 2026 draws out: Lakshya Sen to face Ayush Shetty in first round
item.description: The India Open Super750 tournament is set to take place in New Delhi from January 13th to 18th.

item.title: IOA to convene National Athletes' Forum in Ahmedabad on January 10th
item.description: The Forum will bring together current and former athletes and key stakeholders from across the country for solution-oriented engagement.

item.title: From providing ice to blood banks to Khelo India Beach Games gold: The Raja Das story
item.description: Raja Das won the Pencak Silat gold medal at the 2026 Khelo India Beach Games.

item.title: Bengaluru Open 2026: Dhakshineswar Suresh, Manas Dhamne reach quarters; Sumit Nagal exits
item.description: The 18-year-old Manas clinched his second straight win over a top-300-ranked player.

item.title: Soorma Hockey Club ends Women’s HIL campaign with a win over Shrachi Bengal Tigers
item.description: Sonam starred as Soorma Hockey Club signed off their season with a narrow victory against finalists Shrachi Bengal Tigers in Ranchi.

item.title: Kane Russell's hat-trick powers HIL GC past Shrachi Bengal Tigers
item.description: Hyderabad Toofans also scripted a remarkable comeback to defeat Ranchi Royals 3-2.

item.title: First official FIDE Freestyle Chess World Championship set for February 2026
item.description: FIDE and Freestyle Chess will jointly stage the inaugural World Championship in the Chess960 format with a $300,000 prize fund.

item.title: National shooting coach booked under POCSO Act
item.description: NRAI suspends National pistol coach Ankush Bharadwaj after FIR alleging sexual assault of 17-year-old shooter is registered in Faridabad.
